2608.20961.title: TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids
2608.20961.paper_summary: Modern open models are hybrids: most layers are linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet, GDN) layers carrying a small fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value (KV) cache. This makes ordinary decoding memory-efficient, but hurts speculative decoding. To verify a batch of draft tokens and then roll back the rejected ones, today's systems snapshot the full recurrent state at every draft position for GDN layers, and those snapshots cannot be shared across branches of a draft tree, so a wide, high-acceptance tree becomes memory-infeasible. We remove the snapshots. Using a tree-structured WY transform of the gated delta rule, we compute every draft node's output with a single triangular solve and reconstruct only the one accepted state on commit, storing a small pseudo-value matrix instead of per-node states; the derivation depends only on the gated delta rule, not on any other architectural detail. In serving benchmarks on two scales of one hybrid model family (Qwen3.5 35B and 397B) this cuts speculative recurrent-state memory and KV-cache pressure at identical acceptance length, turning the freed HBM into higher throughput and much lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) wherever memory binds, and costing a few percent where it does not. For tree width the same memory buys affordability: a wider, higher-acceptance draft becomes possible, though not yet a throughput win.
2608.20961.paper_summary_zh: 現代的開放模型是混合型的：大多數層是線性注意力（Gated DeltaNet, GDN）層，攜帶一個小的固定大小的遞迴狀態，而不是不斷增長的鍵值（KV）快取。這使得普通解碼在記憶體上高效，但對推測解碼造成了損害。為了驗證一批草稿標記並回滾被拒絕的標記，當前的系統在每個草稿位置快照完整的遞迴狀態，對於 GDN 層而言，這些快照無法在草稿樹的分支之間共享，因此一棵寬而高接受率的樹變得在記憶體上不可行。我們移除了快照。利用樹狀 WY 變換的 gated delta 規則，我們通過單一的三角形求解計算每個草稿節點的輸出，並在提交時僅重建一個被接受的狀態，存儲一個小的偽值矩陣，而不是每個節點的狀態；推導僅依賴於 gated delta 規則，而不依賴於任何其他架構細節。在對一個混合模型家族（Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B）兩個規模的基準測試中，這減少了推測遞迴狀態的記憶體和 KV 快取的壓力，在相同的接受長度下，將釋放的 HBM 轉化為更高的吞吐量和更低的首次標記時間（TTFT），無論記憶體的約束如何，並在不受約束時花費幾個百分比。對於樹的寬度，相同的記憶體購買了可負擔性：一個更寬、更高接受率的草稿變得可能，儘管尚未實現吞吐量的獲勝。
2608.20961.author: Sneha Murthy Ghantasala et.al.
